text.content: Draft a structured audit report of approximately 250-300 words covering all five dimensions below. Each dimension must include a specific architectural fix.

Memory constraints:

text.content: Identify why passing the entire unfiltered conversation history on every turn will cause performance degradation at scale. Specify what memory management strategy should replace it and what configuration change in the Agent Node's memory settings would implement that strategy.

rich_text.plain_text: Identify why passing the entire unfiltered conversation history on every turn will cause performance degradation at scale. Specify what memory management strategy should replace it and what configuration change in the Agent Node's memory settings would implement that strategy.
Retrieval constraints:

text.content: Identify why simple semantic search without metadata filtering or conflict resolution is insufficient for an agent serving customers across two EU jurisdictions with potentially conflicting policy versions. Specify which retrieval enhancement (source date validation, metadata filtering, or conflict resolution instruction) would address the most critical gap.

Tool constraints:

text.content: Identify what specific failure mode emerges from loading twenty tools simultaneously in the Agent Node's Tools configuration. Takeaway

text.content: The audit skill developed here (reading an agent's architecture against known failure modes and proposing targeted fixes) is directly applicable to Meridian's consultancy work evaluating AI systems built by their clients. A team that can audit an agent they did not build is significantly more valuable than one that can only build agents they designed themselves. Every failure mode in this prototype appeared in some form during the Meridian build. Recognising them in an unfamiliar architecture is the evidence that the course framework has been internalised.
